question: An orchard has 40 peach and pear trees altogether, including 18 peach trees. How many pear trees are there? Calculate: \(40-18=?\)
solution: Subtract the peach trees from the total to find the pear trees. Split 18 into 10 and 8: first \(40-10=30\), then \(30-8=22\). Therefore \(40-18=22\). There are 22 pear trees.
